page_title: ATA 1-2 INT | Atalanta v Inter 04/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+7' None of the Atalanta players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
90+5' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) reacts well to meet the lofted pass on the edge of the six-yard box, but sends a weak header well wide of the right post.
90+2' Rafael Toloi (Atalanta) didn't respect the first warning by the referee and receives a second yellow card, meaning an early finish for him.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
89' A yellow card for a tackle by Denzel Dumfries (Inter). Simone Sozza doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
88' A player from Atalanta commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
86' Simone Inzaghi has decided to substitute Hakan Calhanoglu and he is replaced by Kristjan Asllani (Inter).
86' The referee signals a substitution. Alexis Sanchez (Inter) is brought on as a substitute for Lautaro Martinez.
85' Rafael Toloi (Atalanta) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
85' Luis Muriel (Atalanta) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
84' The ball goes out of play and Atalanta have been awarded a corner kick.

83' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
81' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Yann Sommer easily deals with the threat.
80' Gian Piero Gasperini decides to make a substitution. Teun Koopmeiners will be replaced by Luis Muriel (Atalanta).
80' Ademola Lookman will be replaced by Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta).
77' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
75' Atalanta can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
74' A snap shot by Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Yann Sommer produces a good save to thwart him.
73' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
72' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) sends a cross into the box, but Yann Sommer comes off his line to gather the ball.
70' Simone Inzaghi prepares a substitution. Federico Dimarco is replaced by Carlos Augusto (Inter).
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Davide Frattesi (Inter) replaces Henrikh Mkhitaryan.
69' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
68' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
67' Marcus Thuram (Inter) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
67' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety.
65' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Atalanta, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
62' Substitution. Giorgio Scalvini makes his way off the pitch and Rafael Toloi (Atalanta) comes on as his replacement.

61' 1 - 2 GOAL! Superb work from Ademola Lookman, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta), who beats Yann Sommer with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 1:2.
57' 0 - 2 Goal! Henrikh Mkhitaryan slips it to Lautaro Martinez (Inter) on the edge of the box and he finds the right side of the net with a great effort. The score is 0:2.
56' Francesco Acerbi (Inter) misses the target from a promising position, sending the ball well wide of the left post.
56' Chance! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
55' Substitution. Hans Hateboer (Atalanta) in, Davide Zappacosta out.
55' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) replacing Sead Kolasinac.
54' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) has a goal ruled out for offside!
53' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Inter out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
50' Federico Dimarco (Inter) runs onto the ball and hits a thunderbolt of a shot at goal from the edge of the box, but sends it narrowly wide of the right post.
49' It's a throw-in for Inter.
46' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+7' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+6' Simone Sozza blows his whistle for a foul after Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) hacks down one of his opponents.
45+5' Inter have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
45+4' Nicolo Barella (Inter) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
45+2' Nicolo Barella (Inter) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
45+1' A pass into the penalty area from Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) is intercepted by the defence.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Marcus Thuram (Inter) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
43' Federico Dimarco (Inter) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Juan Musso, who smothers the ball.

42' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
42' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
40' 0 - 1 Goal! Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Juan Musso.
40' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is going to take the penalty!
40' Gian Piero Gasperini appears to have said too much and referee Simone Sozza comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
39' Simone Sozza blows his whistle after Juan Musso (Atalanta) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. The referee points to the penalty spot. It's a penalty for Inter!
38' Francesco Acerbi (Inter) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
37' Federico Dimarco (Inter) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
36' Inter win a direct free kick in a dangerous mid-range position.
35' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) was quite harsh and Simone Sozza didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
34' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
33' Simone Inzaghi is forced to make a change. Benjamin Pavard is unable to continue due to injury, Matteo Darmian (Inter) comes on.
30' The game is interrupted now, Benjamin Pavard (Inter) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
30' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the left post! What a huge opportunity!
28' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
27' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
27' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
26' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) earns the yellow card.
25' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
24' Simone Sozza has a clear sight and sees a foul from Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter). A free kick to Atalanta.
21' A rebound spins to Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) inside the box, but his sliced shot flies just wide of the right post.

20' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
19' Inter enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
17' The resulting corner from Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) is cleared.
16' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
15' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
13' Federico Dimarco (Inter) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
11' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Juan Musso intercepts the ball.
9' Nicolo Barella (Inter) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
9' Ederson (Atalanta) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a clever chip pass, but one of the defending players comes up with a timely interception.
7' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
5' Simone Sozza interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta).
4' Atalanta are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
2' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Atalanta will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Simone Sozza.
